items.t: Chloride: none of the 16 sites with long records here shows a clear rise or fall (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 2.9% in 1985 to 3.6% in 2025 across 1,063 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

191 of 1,063 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 36 for salt or chloride; 210 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 1,063 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 86 of 86 high-need ones have none.
